scope.condensed-matter: Fundamental many-body or solid-state physics, quantum materials, quantum transport/devices, or condensed-matter experiments.
scope.materials-science: Materials discovery, electronic structure, atomistic/continuum simulation, synthesis, processing, or engineering properties.
scope.adjacent-quantum: Quantum computing, circuits, algorithms or quantum information without a specific condensed-matter/materials application.
scope.other-physics: Physics outside condensed matter and materials, including statistical physics of AI unless an actual condensed-matter application is shown.
scope.molecular-chemistry: Molecular chemistry or chemical reactions without a clear solid-state/materials application.
scope.cross-domain-science: Several scientific domains; no single condensed-matter/materials application is primary or established by the abstract.
scope.general-methods: General LLM/agent infrastructure or methods without a demonstrated domain-specific scientific application.
scope.out-of-scope: Medicine, finance, education, social science, unrelated engineering, or other topics outside this review.
scope.unclear: Insufficient information to determine the scientific domain.

use.reasoning-proof: Developing physical arguments, derivations, mathematical proofs, or hypotheses with substantive LLM reasoning.
use.simulation-workflow: Setting up, running, debugging or coordinating scientific calculations and simulation tools.
use.experimental-control: Selecting/acquiring measurements, controlling instruments, or closing an experimental feedback loop.
use.data-interpretation: Interpreting, fitting, labeling, or analyzing scientific measurements or simulation outputs.
use.design-optimization: Proposing and optimizing materials, structures, protocols, or scientific designs.
use.property-prediction: Predicting scientific/material properties with language models, including non-agentic predictors.
use.literature-knowledge: Literature retrieval, extraction, databases, knowledge graphs or scientific information curation.
use.scientific-qa: Scientific question answering, conversational assistance, or domain knowledge tests without an executed research workflow.
use.code-algorithm-generation: Generating or improving scientific code, numerical algorithms, quantum circuits, or executable scientific programs.
use.research-orchestration: Coordinating multiple scientific stages from planning/hypothesis through execution/evaluation; use only for genuinely broad workflows.
use.agent-evaluation: Evaluating general agent capability or reliability where no more specific scientific use is primary.
use.no-substantive-application: No scientific LLM application: e.g. physics of AI, non-language foundation models, or incidental AI/writing mentions.
use.unclear: The abstract does not establish what scientific work the LLM performs.

agent_form.tool-using-agent: LLM chooses or executes tools; multiple agents are not established.
agent_form.multi-agent: Several interacting LLM agents explicitly described; mere LLM ensembles or multiple models are not enough.
agent_form.llm-pipeline: Fixed LLM stages, retrieval, prompting, or extraction pipeline without established agentic control.
agent_form.single-model: Direct LLM prediction or response; no tool use or agency established.
agent_form.human-ai-collaboration: Substantive AI-assisted research under human direction; autonomous tool use is not established.
agent_form.no-llm-application: Non-LLM ML/foundation models, conventional agents, physics of AI, or incidental LLM references.
agent_form.unspecified: LLM/agent use is mentioned but its architecture is not established.

autonomy.single-step: Direct response, prediction or one-shot generation.
autonomy.human-in-loop: A human directs or reviews intermediate scientific steps.
autonomy.bounded-multistep: Agent performs several tool/reasoning steps within an assigned task.
autonomy.not-applicable: No scientific LLM application or pure context/review.
autonomy.unspecified: Cannot establish autonomy from title/abstract; do not infer from the word agent.

breadth.single-task: One bounded prediction, extraction, analysis, proof or algorithmic task.
breadth.workflow: Several connected scientific steps for a specific research objective.
breadth.platform: Reusable infrastructure/framework spanning many tasks or workflows.
breadth.field-overview: Survey, review or perspective across a field.

kind.application: Reports an applied scientific research result or demonstrated application.
kind.method: Introduces a method/framework with domain demonstrations or tests.
kind.benchmark: Primary contribution is a dataset, benchmark or evaluation.
kind.proposal: Proposed application or agenda without a reported demonstration.

llm_role.substantive: An LLM performs scientific work, scientific data processing or research evaluation.
llm_role.proposed: Substantive scientific LLM use is proposed but not demonstrated.
llm_role.incidental: Only writing assistance, background comparison or a passing mention.
llm_role.none: No scientific language-model application is established; generic ML or physics of LLMs does not qualify.

confidence.medium: Some labels are uncertain despite useful evidence.
confidence.low: Missing abstract, ambiguous language, or substantial uncertainty.
